question.problem: Find a fraction that's equivalent to $1 \div (-7).$
question.worked_solution:
We have to divide a positive number $({\color{blue}{1}})$ by a negative one $({\color{red}{-7}}).$ So the result will be negative:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14152110/assets/b3fdb7fe402f5e8ebfdf8502e8173faaaa11082ed9f618884cd1770e764ffaac.svg)

To write down the number that goes in the box, recall that 

$$
1 \div 7 = \dfrac{1}{7}.
$$

Therefore, we get

$$
{\color{blue}{1}} \div {\color{red}{(-7)}} = {\color{red}-\dfrac{1}{7}}.
$$
